objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has modified anti-virus settings to add its own executable to the exclusion list of the endpoint detection solution using the PowerShell command `Add-MpPreference -ExclusionProcess <malware path> -force`.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)(Citation: CarveyODonnellWelchHuntress_TheGentlemen_May2026)
